description: Defines three processor classes (MapProcessor, ReduceProcessor, EmptyProcessor) implementing data transformation logic for a MapReduce workflow using Orleans serialization attributes.

classes.name: MapProcessor
classes.description: Splits input strings into list of words by delimiters.

classes.name: ReduceProcessor
classes.description: Aggregates list of words into a dictionary with word counts.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Transforms input data according to processor logic.
